## Setup of the evaluation

The backend LLM is Deepseek-V3. The reviewer is built on Llama 3.1-8B-Instruct with LoRA (rank 8), trained on NVIDIA A100 GPUs. Because the reviewer is the only trainable component, it was evaluated first, as the Pearson correlation between its scores and human assessments.

The main study recruited **9** AI students (upper-level undergraduates and early graduate students) in a between-subjects design with three groups of three:

- **G1**: web search plus manual reading
- **G2**: an LLM-based tutoring assistant
- **G3**: GoAI Idea Studio

In two hours they did **Frontier Mapping** (a one-page summary of baselines, extensions, contrasts, datasets/tools and prerequisites) and **Creative Ideation** (one or two project ideas). G2 and G3 filled in the System Usability Scale (SUS), and everyone filled in NASA-TLX for workload. The ideas were scored.
